messages:
Evan (Sales): FYI incoming customer intake: NovaHealth wants an on-prem private deployment into an isolated VPC with HSM (no internet egress). They've asked for a firm go31live date to include in the MSA. Can product confirm feasibility and a recommended phased rollout?
Priya (Product): Thanks Evan. Please paste the customer's bullet list here. Need to know target models (LLM size), required QPS, retention/retention period, and any compliance constraints (HIPAA, etc).
Evan (Sales): Key asks: 1) Air-gapped VPC, zero egress, 2) FIPS-validated HSM + PKCS#11, 3) Immutable audit logs retained 365 days, 4) Prefer A100 or equivalent 80GB, 5) Need SOC2/HIPAA language. Target delivery mentioned "~6 weeks".
Marco (Solutions Eng): 6 weeks is optimistic for full production. Recommend phased approach: Phase 0: kickoff + legal/NDA + infra readiness; Phase 1: HSM onboarding + model smoke test (single model, limited tokens); Phase 2: scale validation + observability + SLA testing; Phase 3: cutover + runbook transfer.
Jin (Infra): Technical constraints: if we manage model images and updates, zero egress can work via pre-signed artifact handoff. If customer manages infra, they must provision GPUs and network. ETA if customer preps infra and schedules HSM ceremony: 630+ weeks; if we need to procure or image stuff, 104 weeks.
Rhea (Security): Non-negotiables: HSM must be FIPS-140 level 2+/3 (specify), documented key ceremony, sealed audit logs w/append-only store, signed export process. Also need clarity on whether any telemetry (health checks) is allowed. If strictly zero egress, we'll need manual runbooks for updates.
Evan (Sales): Customer reply: retention 365 days, strict zero egress, can provide on-site ops engineer and approved maintenance window. They're flexible on model family but want high-quality safety review.
Priya (Product): Proposed timeline for SOW table: - Week 031: Kickoff, access, SOW sign-off - Week 236: Phase 1 (HSM import, network validation, smoke tests) - Week 720: Phase 2 (scale tests, observability integration, SLA tests) - Week 13+: Phase 3 (performance tuning, runbook + handoff). Note: this is conditional on customer delivering HSM certs and GPU provisioning within Week 1.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) I'll assemble a minimal onboarding checklist (network ports, DNS, certs, HSM requirements, model artifact format). 2) I'll draft a smoke-test plan (models, token budgets, pass/fail).
Jin (Infra): Initial infra checklist (short): "- GPUs: A100 80GB recommended; fallback A100 40GB or H100 depending on availability - Storage: 6TB model store (local SSD or NFS) - Network: no outbound; management via customer ops VPN/console - KMS: PKCS#11-compatible HSM or wrapped keys - Updates: artifact import process (signed tarball)"
Rhea (Security): I'll prepare a key-ceremony template and required contract language for audit retention and incident response. Also need an exceptions process if customer later allows restricted egress for signed health pings.
DeployBot: ticket created -> INFRA-7342 "NovaHealth private intake: airgap + HSM" (assignee: Jin)
Priya (Product): Draft acceptance criteria (for SOW): 1) Successful HSM key import and AES-256 wrap/unwrap test, 2) Inference correctness smoke tests pass on nominated model(s), 3) Audit logs appended immutably and retained 365 days, 4) Canary traffic at target QPS with rollback validated, 5) Security signoff on key ceremony and EDR/AV allowances. Please review and add anything missing.
Evan (Sales): Need a single1page dependencies list for legal. Can we get that by EOD tomorrow?
Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the checklist and include model compatibility caveats (driver/kernel requirements).
Jin (Infra): I'll validate exact port/IPs and storage sizing and post inline comments by EOD.
Rhea (Security): I'll circulate the key ceremony wording and retention clause; will flag any infeasible items.
Priya (Product): OK team. Priya will compile the one1pager dependencies + acceptance criteria and share with Evan. We'll present the phased SOW to the customer and recommend Week 75 as earliest full prod assuming timely customer readiness.
Evan (Sales): Thanks all. Uploading NovaHealth network diagram and contact.
Jin (Infra): Got it, will review.
Priya (Product): Tagging for product intake review. If no blocks, we'll lock the phased plan and send to the customer with clear acceptance criteria and dependencies. :thumbsup:
